_comment: Prevent Damage (2026-09-27, phase I2). Rolling Earthquake's X is a SEARCHED axis, not 'all the
mana'. Board: Tamanoa (2/4) + Vito (1/3), both sick; four Mountains; hand: Rolling Earthquake.
X = 3 (the max) kills Vito in the creature pass BEFORE the Tamanoa gain resolves, so nothing is
drained: opponent 17. X = 2 keeps Vito: one event of 2 x (2 creatures + 2 players) = 8 ->
Tamanoa gains 8 -> Vito drains 8: opponent 20 - 2 - 8 = 10, us 20 - 2 + 8 = 26. The search
must find X = 2; GenericProvider's historical {max} rule would have cast X = 3.
